title: Puzzle 2D Context Menu Parity
description: Replicate puzzle3d viewport selection context menu and document tree context menu in puzzle2d, with full hidden/locked flag parity and suggest-nodes brush menu.
summary: Fixed suggest-nodes menu hover preview and click placement. Root cause: opening the menu published candidates with `preview: null`, and hover relied on synchronous WASM `brushSetCandidateIndex` drains that often never updated the shared session (reentry blocks / missing preview payload). Added TS-side `puzzle2dBuildBrushSuggestionsPreview` + `puzzle2dApplyBrushSuggestionsCandidateIndex` to compute slot previews from scene geometry + catalog templates, publish full session snapshots (with preview) to driving + mirror panes, and use the driving renderer ref for hover/select. Menu open now seeds index-0 preview; commit builds preview before fixture place. Rust mirror: rebuild/sync preview events when session JSON omits preview but lists candidates.
